primary.title: Do small caps really deliver higher earnings growth than large caps? Here's what investors need to know
primary.summary: Small- and mid-cap stocks have delivered much faster earnings growth than large caps over the long term. But a closer look at margins, recent performance and the impact of a few extreme performers reveals why investors should look beyond headline profit growth.
